entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's nice having some light again.[n]I slammed my face right into a wall[n]earlier in that darkness.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose humans do gain most of their[n]information from their eyes. That was a[n]most troublesome trap.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But if she's throwing such tough problems[n]at us, that only serves to prove how far in[n]we've made it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's right. We're just about in the final[n]stages of the Palace now.
